status: pre-registered before any measured run; the probe runs aodl-probe-net-01 and aodl-probe-doctor-01 only checked the launcher and are not results
question: Does the bend-native plugin, used through the supported 'hermes bend verify' and 'hermes bend replay' commands, give a real downstream proof project (the z0intelligence AODL structural gate) receipts that (a) pass under stock Bend 2.0.34 and under the patched candidate kvnloo/bend@17db447a, (b) replay offline to an identical verdict and identity, and (c) change verdict and go stale when one byte of a law or of the implementation changes?

context.rfc: kvnloo/hermes-agent#324 meta triage (2026-10-01): no broad semantic matrix; focus on kernel provenance (#388), release qualification (#389) and dependency provenance / replayable receipts (#390). This lane is a downstream-consumer check on replayable receipts and on running the patched candidate over a real proof project outside the Bend corpus (one input to the #389 next gate; not the gate itself).
context.ownership: Hermes orchestrates and executes tools. Bend checks proof evidence over the emitted BendTT book only (verification_scope bend-emitted-book, source_semantics_attested false). z0intelligence owns admission and outcome decisions. AODL owns intent and authority. A proof PASS here is evidence about the Bend kernel's own decision functions over the Core IR; it is never whole-task success, never an admission decision and never grants authority.

decision_rules.lane_pass: P1-P6 hold on every run. P7 is descriptive.
decision_rules.deviation: Any deviation is reported as a finding with the raw receipt. No run is dropped; an infrastructure failure may be retried once under a new id (-02 suffix for that id), and both attempts stay in the denominators.
decision_rules.plugin_behaviour: The plugin is not modified on this branch. A plugin defect is a finding with evidence, not a code change.
decision_rules.timing: No latency is measured or reported. duration_ms fields in receipts are incidental and are not results.

restated_not_measured.authority: The canonical AODL validator (aodl_contract.validator.validate) stays authoritative.
